Part 3 of north-foster-farm/nff-agentic-workflow#1. Adds `scripts/` with four helpers that replace the coordinator's session scripts: `set-field.sh` (Stage, Owner, Kind), `file-tree.sh` (a JSON tree filed as sub-issues), `link-blocker.sh` (blocked-by, with `--remove`) and `move-milestone.sh`. Usage is in `scripts/README.md`.

**Proven live** against scratch issues in this repo (now closed): typed issue create, sub-issue linking, all three fields in one call, blocker link and unlink, and a milestone move. Writing a field value takes the option's name and a POST replaces the existing value. Setting several fields in one call needs a JSON body; `gh`'s `[]` syntax mis-groups them (found and fixed).

**Tests.** `tests/run.sh` runs 31 checks against a stub `gh` that replays responses recorded from the real API today (`tests/fixtures/`). The two milestone and issue fixtures are trimmed to the fields the scripts read.

**Not proven live: cross-repository calls.** I may not write to the site or dashboard repos, so cross-repo behavior (the other repo's id and path) is covered by the stub tests only. The sub-issue and blocked-by APIs take a database id, which `issue_id` reads from the other issue's own repo. A first real cross-repo link will prove it.

**Not in this PR.** The `poll.sh` Stage, new blocked-by and 24-hour hard-block reporting from #1 is not in my brief's list of four parts; say if you want it as a fifth PR.

Part 2 of north-foster-farm/nff-agentic-workflow#1. Copies the bullpen into this repo: `bullpen/` (roster, `common.md`, standing role briefs, `bullpen.sh`, `poll.sh`) and `docs/` (`multi-agent-workflow.md`, `cloud-lanes.md`). Nothing else was read or copied from the workspace.

**Stripped.** Family first names in `common.md`, the staging host, the site's town in the wording rule, a release-runbook path, secret names in `cloud-lanes.md`, and the finished-work notes in the qa and project-manager briefs. Scans for emails, phone numbers, addresses, absolute home paths and token-like strings find nothing; the remaining "secret" and "token" hits are rule text.

**Judgment calls for the reviewer.**
- I copied only the standing roles (coordinator, liaison, project-manager, qa, security, communications, workflow). The other ~40 briefs are finished one-off rounds that quote issue comments and, in one case, a street address; the coordinator's own brief says to rewrite them from scratch anyway. Say if you want any of them added after a scrub.
- The roster keeps only those roles, plus format comments. `qa` now points at `lanes/qa` instead of a private worktree path.
- `sandbox.json`, `shims/` and `serve.py` stay in the workspace (not on the list). `bullpen.sh` still reads them from the roster's folder; `bullpen/README.md` says so.
- `common.md` and the coordinator brief now point at `planning.md`. They still restate some rules (the #527 pass over them, and both repos' CLAUDE.md, come after review).
- Fixed a stale line: the workflow doc's model table said Opus and medium; the roster says Sonnet at low. Dated in the file.
- Scripts are verbatim except for what is listed above; a few lines exceed 80 columns as in the originals.

Security review requested by #1 (reviewer: security).

Part 1 of north-foster-farm/nff-agentic-workflow#1. Adds `planning.md`, the rules adopted in north-foster-farm/north-foster-farm#527 on 2026-11-11, as one doc: the tree, Stage/Owner/Kind fields, `needs:` labels, milestones, blockers as owned issues, depth gate, parallel rule, no estimates, cross-repo links, review runs.

It refers to `labels.json`, the helper scripts and `plan-check.yml`, which arrive in later PRs. It also records that fields live in the issue body until the org fields exist (#542 on the site repo).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

The planning rules adopted in north-foster-farm/north-foster-farm#527 aren't wired into the bullpen. Since adoption (2026-11-11) the coordinator has applied them by hand with session-only scripts. This issue makes them part of how the bullpen runs, in both repos, and gives the process its home here.

## Done when

- [ ] The bullpen lives in this repo (roster, roles, `common.md`, `bullpen.sh`, `poll.sh`, `docs/multi-agent-workflow.md`, `docs/cloud-lanes.md`), with nothing private in it: no secrets, customer data, family names or mockup source. The workspace and the skill point here. (reviewer: security)
- [ ] The #527 rules are written here as one doc, and `coordinator.md`, `common.md` and both repos' CLAUDE.md point to it instead of restating it. (James)
- [ ] `coordinator.md` covers the tree, the Stage, Owner and Kind fields, the `needs:` labels, milestones, blockers as owned issues, and the depth gate, with the commands for each. (reviewer: qa)
- [ ] Saved helpers replace the session scripts: file a tree under a parent, set Stage, Owner or Kind, link a blocker, move an issue to the next milestone. Each works across both repos. (test)
- [ ] `poll.sh` reports each lane-held issue's Stage, any new blocked-by links, and hard blocks owned by James older than 24 hours. (test)
- [ ] The plan-check reusable workflow checks and reports without rewriting a body, and both repos call it. (test, then one live run per repo)
- [ ] The shared label list is synced to both repos. (test)

Owner: claude. Dashboard lanes themselves (worktree kind, cloud-run workflow) are under north-foster-farm/nff-dashboard#43.
